purpose: Current available action context, selective rehydration and retirement.
use: Every interaction and governed action: load or rehydrate the closure; prepare effects and apply scoped procedures and declaration (R26).
semantic_conditions: Changed context invalidates affected reuse; preparation and procedural candidates require current bindings and attributed semantic review.
mandatory_preconditions: Current route, closure identities and context integrity state.
postconditions_verification: Only valid context reused; stale or missing context rehydrated before dependent effects.
